usageNotes: Use this to enumerate all SDN VNets defined in the cluster's Software-Defined Networking configuration. SDN must be enabled on the cluster and at least one zone must exist before any VNets will appear. Pass `pending=true` to inspect unapplied changes (e.g., after creating a VNet but before running `pvesh create /cluster/sdn` to apply), or `running=true` to see only what is currently active on the data plane.

examples.summary: List all VNets with pending changes visible

tips: A VNet with `state: new` or `state: changed` has been configured but not yet applied — call the SDN apply endpoint to push it to nodes.
The `tag` field means a VLAN tag for VLAN/QinQ zones and a VXLAN VNI for VXLAN/EVPN zones — the semantics differ by zone type.
Results are filtered by the caller's permissions: only VNets under zones where the token has `SDN.Audit` or `SDN.Allocate` on `/sdn/zones/<zone>/<vnet>` are returned.
Use `digest` from each returned VNet as an optimistic-lock token when submitting updates to prevent overwriting concurrent changes.
